what: the grasp of each module the reference uses, in the module's part body frame (metres; the frame of the kit's body at the design pose): closing axis, approach (from the hand into the part), centre (midway between the two pad faces' middles), the module's width across the pads there

head.why: the head's chosen grasp (closing across the head's top from above): usable at the pick and at the mate in all 301 layouts of the fixtures of record (nominal + 300 seeds), the open hand 4 mm clear of everything, the largest torsion margin

leg_R.why: the leg's chosen grasp (from the front, closing across the thigh): usable at the pick and at the mate in all 301 layouts of the fixtures of record (4 such grasps); the largest torsion margin among them whose non-pad robot geoms keep >= 2 mm from the leg's collision pieces when the first pad touches (4.82 mm)

leg_L.why: the leg's chosen grasp (from the front, closing across the thigh): usable at the pick and at the mate in all 301 layouts of the fixtures of record (97 such grasps); the largest torsion margin among them whose non-pad robot geoms keep >= 2 mm from the leg's collision pieces when the first pad touches (2.50 mm)

arm_R.why: the right arm's chosen grasp (the shoulder pitch link from above, closing front to back): usable at the pick and at the mate in all 301 layouts of the fixtures of record; torsion margin 1.971 at 0.5 m/s2; the open hand 7.0 mm off the torso at the seat

arm_L.why: the left arm's chosen grasp (the shoulder pitch link from above, closing front to back): usable at the pick and at the mate in all 301 layouts of the fixtures of record; torsion margin 1.784 at 0.5 m/s2; chosen over an earlier, superseded grasp of the left arm (the same family) because the pads keep their force once the arm's weight is in the hand

frames.head: the head's part body frame
frames.leg_R: the right thigh body's frame (= the leg's part body frame at the delivered state)
frames.leg_L: the left thigh body's frame (= the leg's part body frame at the delivered state)
